slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Yes. We design, migrate, secure, back up and manage Azure environments, and we run Azure Virtual Desktop where it fits. As a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider the licensing and support come direct from us, so escalation goes straight to Microsoft rather than through a reseller.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: Can you actually control Azure costs?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Yes, and it is usually the quickest win available. Right-sizing machines that were sized for a worst case, shutting down test environments out of hours, removing orphaned disks and IP addresses, and applying reservations or savings plans to workloads that clearly run permanently. Then tagging everything so the next bill can be explained without a forensic exercise.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Is Azure cheaper than our own servers?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Not automatically, and anyone who promises that without looking at your workloads is guessing. Azure wins clearly on variable demand, disaster recovery, avoiding a large hardware purchase, and anything you need to scale quickly. A steady predictable workload can cost more in Azure if it is left on pay as you go rates and never reviewed. The honest answer comes from modelling your actual usage.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: Can you migrate our servers to Azure?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Yes, from a single workload up to your whole estate. Some servers move unchanged, some are better rebuilt on the way over, and occasionally the right answer is that something stays where it is for now. We work that out during discovery rather than moving everything and sorting it out later.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: Is Azure Virtual Desktop right for us?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: It depends on the problem you are solving. It is strong for unmanaged or personal devices, contractors, keeping data off endpoints, awkward legacy applications and onboarding quickly. It is weaker as a straight cost saving against buying laptops, because session hosts bill while they run. If you already have Business Premium or Windows E3 or E5 the desktop entitlement is usually included, which changes the maths considerably.

slots.label: Question 6
slots.default: How do you secure an Azure environment?

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: Starting with identity, because that is the real perimeter. Multi-factor authentication enforced, conditional access, administrative rights granted temporarily rather than held permanently, and network segmentation so one compromised machine cannot reach everything. Then monitoring that produces a ticket a person picks up, and backups an attacker cannot reach.
